class.name: HTMLAudioElement
class.brief_description: An audio element with optional media controls.
class.description: An [HTMLLabel] owns the audio player for a connected element. Use [member src] or child [code]<source>[/code] elements to select an imported project audio resource.

method.name: pause
method.description: Pauses playback at the current position.

method.name: play
method.description: Starts or resumes playback. Returns an error if the element has no playback host or no source can be loaded by the selected backend.

members.member: Starts playback automatically at runtime. Editor previews start on user input.
Shows the playback controls for the audio element.
Returns the project resource path of the selected audio source.
The playback position, in seconds. Assigning a value seeks within the loaded audio stream.
The duration of the loaded audio, in seconds.
Restarts playback when the audio stream ends.
Whether the audio output is muted. The HTML attribute provides the initial value.
Whether playback is paused or stopped.
The audio source URL, relative to the HTML document or using [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code], or [code]uid://[/code]. When the attribute is omitted, sources are tried in child order.
The linear playback volume from [code]0.0[/code] to [code]1.0[/code].
